text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Warning, interfering DECT equipment on the rise!", "gist": "Interference from DECT equipment is increasing."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Interference on UMTS mobile telephone networks (Universal Mobile Telecommunications System) has been increasing over recent months.", "gist": "UMTS network interference has increased recently."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "DECT cordless phones (Digital Enhanced Cordless Telecommunications)", "gist": "DECT cordless phones"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "OFCOM", "gist": "OFCOM (the UK communications regulator)"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "purchased outside Europe – for example in the US, South America, Canada or Asia – or on the internet", "gist": "DECT phones bought outside Europe or online cause interference"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "billing those responsible for importing and operating such cordless phones for the cost of identifying and rectifying the source of interference", "gist": "OFCOM may bill importers and operators for interference resolution costs"}]}
